ClausePartitionProductSAT:
∀ (test : List Bool → Bool)
    (ht : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) Computability.encodeBool test)
    (B : Language Bool) (hB : B ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P)
    (hunit : ∀ c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause, c.length ≤ 1 → test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c) = true)
    (hbase : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, (∀ c ∈ φ, test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c) = true) →
       (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ B ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ))
    (q : Polynomial ℕ), ∃ D : Language Bool, D ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P ∧ ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF,
      ((φ.filter (fun c => !test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c))).map List.length).prod ≤ q.eval (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length →
        (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ D ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ)
ExactClausePartitionProductSAT:
∀ (test : List Bool → Bool)
    (ht : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) Computability.encodeBool test)
    (B : Language Bool) (hB : B ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P)
    (hunit : ∀ c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause, c.length ≤ 1 → test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c) = true)
    (hbase : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, (∀ c ∈ φ, test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c) = true) →
       (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ B ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ))
    (q : Polynomial ℕ), {x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      ((φ.filter (fun c => !test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c))).map List.length).prod ≤ q.eval x.length ∧
      PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
ExactHornProductSAT:
∀ (q : Polynomial ℕ), {x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      ((φ.filter (fun c => 1 < (c.filter fun l => l.2).length)).map List.length).prod ≤ q.eval x.length ∧
      PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
ExactHornSAT:
{x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      (∀ c ∈ φ, (c.filter fun l => l.2).length ≤ 1) ∧ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
HornClosureCompleteness:
∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF)
    (hHorn : ∀ c ∈ φ, (c.filter (fun l => l.2)).length ≤ 1)
    (hSat : PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ), ∃ s : Finset ℕ, PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval (fun i => decide (i ∈ s)) φ = true ∧
      (∀ i ∈ s, ∃ c ∈ φ, ∃ l ∈ c, l.1 = i) ∧
      ∀ σ : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment, PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval σ φ = true → ∀ i ∈ s, σ i = true
IndexedWitnessProjection:
∀ (R : Set (List Bool × List Bool))
    (hR : PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R)
    (clock : List Bool → List Bool)
    (hc : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) clock)
    (generate : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool)
    (hg : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) generate), {x : List Bool | ∃ i < (clock x).length, (x, generate (List.replicate i true, x)) ∈ R} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
MeasuredCNFPartition:
∀ (test : List Bool → Bool)
    (ht : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) Computability.encodeBool test), ∃ pack : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) pack ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF,
        let a := PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ((φ.filter (fun c => test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c))).reverse)
        let b := PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ((φ.filter (fun c => !test (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c))).reverse)
        pack (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = List.replicate a.length true ++ false :: (a ++ b)
MeasuredCappedClauseProduct:
∃ product : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) product ∧
      ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (cap : List Bool),
        (product (cap,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ)).length = min cap.length ((φ.map List.length).prod)
MeasuredClauseLiteralCount:
∃ count : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) count ∧
      ∀ c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause, count (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c) = List.replicate c.length true
MeasuredFirstClause:
∃ split : List Bool → List Bool × List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) PEqualNP.Library.encodePair split ∧
      split [] = ([],[]) ∧
      ∀ (c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause) (tail : List Bool),
        split (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c ++ tail) = (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c, tail)
MeasuredHornGuard:
{x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      ∀ c ∈ φ, (c.filter fun l => l.2).length ≤ 1} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
MeasuredHornSAT:
∃ D : Language Bool, D ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P ∧ ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF,
      (∀ c ∈ φ, (c.filter fun l => l.2).length ≤ 1) →
      (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ D ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ)
MeasuredHornSweep:
∃ sweep : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) sweep ∧
      ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (vs : List ℕ), ∃ ys : List ℕ,
        sweep (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,vs.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true])) =
          ys.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true]) ∧
        (ys.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true])).length ≤
          (vs.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true])).length +
            (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length
MeasuredLiteralChoice:
∃ pick : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) pick ∧
      ∀ (c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause) (index : List Bool),
        pick (index, PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause (Option.toList (getElem? c index.length))
MeasuredMixedRadixUnits:
∃ choose : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) choose ∧
      (∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (ix : List Bool), ∃ units : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 1 units ∧
        choose (ix, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF units ∧
        ∀ σ : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment, PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval σ units = true → PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval σ φ = true) ∧
      ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (σ : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment), PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval σ φ = true →
        ∃ i < (φ.map List.length).prod, ∃ units : PEqualNP.Search.CNF,
          choose (List.replicate i true, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF units ∧ PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval σ units = true
MeasuredPositiveLiteral:
∃ first : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) first ∧
      ∀ c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause, first (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c) =
        ((c.filter fun l => l.2).head?).elim []
          (fun l => (l.1.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true])
MeasuredUnaryDivMod:
∃ divide : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool × List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair PEqualNP.Library.encodePair divide ∧
      ∀ a b : List Bool,
        divide (a,b) = (List.replicate (a.length / b.length) true,
          List.replicate (a.length % b.length) true)
